notes: The statistical query the repo demonstrates via in-memory SQLite in R: avg/stdev/variance/median of AGE for age<13. Rendered natively in PROC SQL against the HAVE table the repo builds from sashelp.class; aggregates, aliases (Avg/Stdev/Var/Median), and the age<13 filter match the original SQL. Runs clean on Jenner v1.5.39; WANT has 1 obs, 4 vars.
